text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — Vendor Altis offered a bulk lane for EU H100s with a 6-8 week window but with two catches: 1) 5% holdback on arrival for QA, 2) RMA handling requires depot handoff in FRA and separate AWB for returns. Pricing: €42k/unit if we accept split-lane.

Kai Thompson: split-lane = they consolidate at origin then split in FRA? any extra freight cost estimate?

Maria Chen: yes, they consolidate then crossdock in FRA. They quoted a +€250/awbdrop for split processing, and a one-time handling fee of €1.2k for customs reclass per container.

Oliver Patel: what's the warranty/RMA SLA? DOA rate we assume ~1% — who covers return freight and depot repair?

Maria Chen: vendor says they cover DOA return freight (prepaid labels) for 30 days, after that customer pays. Depot repair SLA 14 business days for EU depot. They want a signed RMA-authorization template — attached snippet below from their email:

Jules (logistics): ```
RMA-TEMPLATE: ALT-RA-2026-XXXX
Return flow: customer -> FRA depot (prepaid) -> repair -> exchange / refurb -> return to pool
KPI: depot intake -> disposition: 10bd
```

Kai Thompson: +€250/awbdrop scales with # of split shipments; if we take 240 units and they split into 6 AWBs, that's +€1500. Also the 5% holdback = 12 units withheld until QA pass? that impacts provisioning schedule.

Maria Chen: correct. They proposed releasing holdback in weekly waves after photo inspection and serial reconciliation. Means our earliest usable capacity drops by 12 units for ~1 week. Can we accept that without breaking bookings?

Oliver Patel: depends on cluster needs. EU demand forecast for next 8 weeks still shows 180 units required for rolling capacity. If we lose 12 temporarily it's okay, but if any delay >2 weeks we need to trigger contingency.

Jules (logistics): vendor offered an optional pre-accept inspection at origin (+€600/container) that would remove the 5% holdback. Might be worth if it prevents holdback + reduces RMA churn.

Maria Chen: decision points for procurement: accept split-lane with holdback, or pay origin-inspection to remove holdback. Tradeoffs: up-front cost vs delayed usable units and extra AWB fees. Also need vendor to confirm they will include a single consolidated RMA portal with batch RAs (we don't want per-unit manual RAs).

Kai Thompson: ask them for: 1) sample RMA CSV export, 2) explicit depot SLA in contract, 3) cap on DOA freight liability after 30 days.

Maria Chen: I'll ask and push for consolidated RMA portal + CSV. Also negotiating to cap origin-inspection at €400/container.

dhl-bot: Carrier note: AWB example `203-ALTS-987654321`; estimated FRA crossdock dwell 24-48h for split processing.

Oliver Patel: one more ask — include firmware snapshot and serial batch photo before shipment. speeds triage for depot.

Maria Chen: good call. I'll add that. I'll update once vendor confirms CSV export and final origin-inspection price. :thumbsup:
